name: Venus in the Morning
source: Melody is  a sickly  half-vampire obsessed with the fact that someone stole something from her or she lost it. Melody has constant memory loss and delirium, even so, she's destined to find the crimson redhead who taught her to draw, maybe she's the one  who has what she's looking for. Venus in the Morning is an experimental visual novel that mixes solarpunk utopian  aesthetics, existential  and psychological themes
